fieldNotes.location: Confirmed: 1025 Locust Point Rd, Manchester PA. Roster ROOFTOP geocode 40.070433,-76.746475 lands squarely on the building. A single very large (~1.3M sq ft) DC building, oriented NE-SW, on a 129-acre parcel along the I-83 corridor in York County. Web-corroborated as UNFI's Class-A tri-temp build-to-suit, opened Q1 FY25.
fieldNotes.imageryState: Best available Maxar satellite shows the site MID-CONSTRUCTION: the building shell is complete (NE half with a finished dark roof, SW half with a lighter still-being-finished roof), but perimeter paving, parking striping, and yard buildout are incomplete; only ~40 trailers were visible. The facility is operational per public reporting (opened Q1 FY25); counts below rely on the published developer spec, not on a count of finished imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Published spec: 214 dock positions. Dock doors are visible lining BOTH long faces of the building (NW and SE) -> dockDoors band 50+.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Published spec: 492 trailer parking spaces -> dropArea band 50+, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on the two opposite long faces of the building -> shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A single truck entrance from the SW via a dedicated access road off Locust Point Rd; a guard-booth-scale structure and gated checkpoint are at the campus entry (~40.0668,-76.7448). Modern build-to-suit grocery DC -> assume staffed guard booth (guardShack true). Gate/booth not fully resolved in construction-era imagery -> flagged.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long dedicated access road from the public road to the gate; deep approach -> drivewayLong true, ample queue room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide access road and large open apron at the gate -> physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Parcel is surrounded by farmland, woods, and scattered rural residences in York County, off the I-83 corridor -> Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed entering the property; truck-served grocery DC.
fieldNotes.entryLanes/exitLanes: Estimated 2/2 for a 214-dock facility; not precisely counted in construction-era imagery.
